audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Fiora Level 6 and 2+ items, contradicting the page's own spike and why text (Insanity Potion flips the lane; 2+ items is a Singed split-push engine) and the 49.84% win rate.
audit.why: phases[4]/phases[6] and win[4]/win[6] must agree with the prose and the data; a near-even matchup cannot be 5/7 Fiora.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Skill (both ults land at 6), 2+ items -> Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 text talks about 'ult-ghost-proxy' generically and never states what Insanity Potion actually does to Fiora.
audit.why: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts Duelist's Dance Vital healing and Grand Challenge's heal — the single biggest spike interaction in this lane.
audit.corrected: State the Grievous Wounds application at 6 and that Grand Challenge is a 110s cooldown at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions are absent: Mega Adhesive's grounding shuts off Lunge, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds counters both of Fiora's heal sources. The Riposte-parries-Fling-into-a-stun interaction is stated but without its cooldown.
audit.why: Riposte (W) 24/22/20/18/16s parries all damage and stuns if it blocks an immobilizing effect — Fling is a knockup, so it converts to a stun. Mega Adhesive grounds, and grounding denies dashes; Lunge is Fiora's only dash (13s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5).
audit.corrected: Add: glue first to ground Lunge, Fling only once Riposte is spent, and Insanity Potion's poison Grievous Wounds through Vital heals.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown section names Riposte but gives no numbers and omits the Lunge/grounding window.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Riposte 24s at rank 1; Mega Adhesive grounds Lunge.

audit.why: Rylai's first plus early anti-heal is already correct and matches the Grievous Wounds plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] title 'Deny her vitals by moving' is paired with a description about wasting Riposte — the two do not match.
audit.why: Mismatched trigger/description reads as noise on the loading screen.
audit.corrected: Point the description at Mega Adhesive grounding Lunge.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Fiora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, gutting her Vital heals — but Grand Challenge lands at 6 too, so this level is even.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Fiora carry threat 10/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Rylai's holds her in the poison, Grievous Wounds caps her healing, and she answers your split alone.

edits.before: Fiora wastes Riposte — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds Lunge — she cannot dash to a fresh Vital.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Grand Challenge is 110s at rank 1 — disengage and she has nothing.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns. Don’t fling into it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: 24s at rank 1 — it parries Fling and the block converts into a stun on you, so Fling only after it is spent. - Mega Adhesive grounds Lunge: glue first, then commit. - Insanity Potion: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries + stuns. Don’t fling into it. When it is down — Poison-kite + fling her.
edits.after: Riposte parries Fling and stuns you for it, 24s at rank 1. Glue first — Mega Adhesive grounds Lunge.

edits.before: Insanity Potion's armor, MR, and regen absorb a Vital proc without threatening your HP bar; begin the run-at-her pattern and let poison attrition punish any chase she commits to.
edits.after: Insanity Potion's armor, MR and regen absorb a Vital proc, and its Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail cuts her Duelist's Dance healing — but she ults at 6 as well, so the level reads even.

notes: Level chart flipped as one group across both layers. Fiora's Grand Challenge (110/90/70s) and Duelist's Dance both heal, so Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds is the defining level-6 interaction and was entirely absent. Fiora's Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her damage scales with attack speed, not just AD — flagged but not written, no length budget left.
